# Selected HeliCorgi source dependencies

These are the `Formal` modules used by the current article proof/test closure.
They come from the source snapshot recorded as
`de518485776d1d8de60f0c51151121df71e3ab6d` of
https://github.com/HeliCorgi/ns-mns2-flowmap-bridge.

The original LICENSE is retained. This directory is a source library compiled
in place by `formalization/lakefile.toml` under the main Lean/Mathlib pin, not a
standalone project or a complete upstream checkout. Use `make test` at the
repository root.
